instructions: Completed for the Order Intake (Alternative A) submission.

development_tools_and_models.notes: Claude Code (claude.ai/code desktop app) running model id claude-sonnet-5, used interactively to write essentially all of orderintake/, bin/, app.py, templates/, and this documentation. The implementation was first built and fully verified in PHP, then ported to this Python/Flask stack -- see the worked example for the bugs found at each stage, including one genuinely new bug the Python/Flask port itself surfaced.

plugins_and_extensions.notes: No Claude Code plugins or editor extensions beyond the default desktop app were used for this exercise.

application_models_and_parameters.notes: The APPLICATION itself (not the dev tool) calls Anthropic model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (configurable via CLAUDE_MODEL in .env) via the official `anthropic` Python SDK (client.messages.create), max_tokens=1024, temperature left at the API default (unset). System prompt is the SYSTEM_PROMPT constant in orderintake/ai/extractor.py. Haiku was chosen over Sonnet after estimating cost for this narrow segmentation task -- see README.md.

skills.notes: The starter pack's skills/generate-assignment-data/SKILL.md was read for guidance but not installed/invoked as a Claude Code skill -- the 7 added request files (R5-R11) were handwritten directly against domain.md instead.

agent_instructions_and_subagents.notes: No project-specific CLAUDE.md, subagents, or custom agent instructions were created for this standalone repo; default Claude Code behavior was used throughout.

hooks_and_scripts.notes: No Claude Code hooks (PreToolUse/PostToolUse/etc.) were configured for this exercise.

prompts_and_rules.notes: The only durable prompt artifact is the application's own extraction system prompt, committed in source. No separate Claude Code rule/instruction files were authored for this repo.

tool_and_mcp_settings.notes: Default Claude Code tool permissions (Read/Write/Edit/Bash) in the desktop app's standard permission-prompt mode; no custom MCP servers were added or needed for this exercise.

permissions_and_environment_names.notes: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CLAUDE_MODEL, and (after switching Storage to MySQL so results could be viewed in phpMyAdmin) DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME are read by the application (orderintake/env.py). No credentials are committed; .env and .venv/ are gitignored, and .env has never been tracked or committed in git history (verified via `git log --all --diff-filter=A --name-only`).
